finding: Whole body-weight trajectories of individual animals are identical across different experiments (different challenge timing, age cohorts and even mouse strains), in several cases with exact-integer edits on the remaining days.
quantitative_evidence: 18 cross-experiment animal pairs share >=4 identical live (non-carried-forward) weight readings vs 0.005 pairs expected by chance (126,074 pairs compared; dup_chance_benchmark.csv). Examples: 6 of 7 "3d Vaccine+PSLN-344" animals (S15-I) = S15-C PSLN-344 animals on days 2-12; S15-M young C57BL/6 controls I-N = S09-E young BALB/c PSLN-344(Y) X-AC; S15-M PSLN-344 AE/AF = S15-A PSLN-344 X/Y with offsets of -1.0 and -2.0 on days 2 and 8.
claims_affected: Rapid (3-day) protection (S15-H/I); cross-strain protection in C57BL/6 and Swiss Webster (S15-L/M, S15-N/O); 180-day durability in young (S09-F/G); companion weights for S06-A/S06-C.
required_action: Retrieve raw balance logs (grams) and animal IDs for every body-weight block; establish which record is original; re-derive all % values; if not traceable, exclude the experiment and refer to research-integrity process.

finding: Time-to-event records of two different experiments (challenge on day 14 vs day 3) are identical for all four groups, row for row; the companion weights for S06-D (S15-D) show two PSLN-344 and two PSLN-212(Y) animals flat-lining (carried-forward = dead by the workbook convention) although S06-D records 7/7 survival.
quantitative_evidence: Identity of 28 rows x 5 columns (integrity_checks.csv); S15-D cols W, AC, F, G constant from day 8-10 to day 14.
claims_affected: Rapid heterosubtypic protection (S06-D, 7/7) and H5N1 protection (S06-C).
required_action: Recover original mortality logs for both experiments; treat S06-D as unverified until then.

finding: Alveolar-macrophage (%) and neutrophil (%) panels share identical per-animal values in the same positions for 1-2 of 5 animals in every group at every time point.
quantitative_evidence: 35 of 100 position-matched values identical; chance expectation 0.85 (max 6 in 20,000 permutations); all other comparable block pairs show 0-1 identical values.
claims_affected: Any claim about alveolar macrophages or neutrophils after PSLN-344 (not used in MoA).
required_action: Re-export from FCS files; exclude both blocks until resolved.

finding: Day-12 body weights of all 8 PSLN-212(Y) animals are identical to those of all 8 PSLN-344(Y) animals.

Values recur between two AEC-uptake experiments under different labels (S01-B AECII/PSLN-SRB shares 17.7, 17.5, 12.2 with S08-C AECII-PSLN-SRB; S01-B AECI/PSLN-SRB shares 4.92, 4.13 with S08-C AECII-PSLN-344-SRB).
quantitative_evidence: 3/5 and 2/5 exact matches at 3-4 significant figures under different group labels.
claims_affected: AECII targeting by the vehicle (S01-B) and the finding that Mn reduces AEC uptake ~4-fold (S08-C).
required_action: Re-export both from FCS files; treat AEC-targeting claims as unverified.

blocks: S03-B, S03-F vs S13-A to S13-D
finding: Printed IgG2a/IgG1 quotients reproduce exactly from the S13 subclass titres, but with group labels cyclically rotated (S03 "PSLN-212" = S13 "PSLN-212(Y)"; S03 "PSLN-344" = S13 "PSLN-212"; S03 "PSLN-212(Y)" = S13 "PSLN-344").
quantitative_evidence: Max relative error <0.07% for the rotated mapping (check_IgG2a_IgG1_labels.csv). S13 labelling is the one consistent with total IgG ranking (S03-A/E).
claims_affected: Th1 (IgG2a) skew claim: under S13 labels PSLN-344 raises IgG2a/IgG1 from 0.55 to 1.85 (H1N1); under S03 labels it lowers it.
required_action: Confirm plate maps; until then do not use IgG subclass ratio as evidence or biomarker.

finding: Second S09-A panel is labelled "16h" but every group matches the S01-A 72 h values; the S09-A "PBS" group equals the S01-A "Sham" (empty liposome) group.
quantitative_evidence: Ifnb1: 21/21 panel-2 values match S01-A 72 h (+/-0.01); 3/3 "PBS" values match S01-A "Sham".
claims_affected: Kinetics of cytokine induction; vehicle vs buffer attribution.
required_action: Relabel panel 2 as 72 h; correct PBS/Sham identity.

finding: Body-weight blocks described as "the animals of" a survival block contradict it: different group sets (S13-F has "Naive", lacks CMP-204; S13-G has "Naive", lacks PSLN-212), different survivor counts (S03-I PSLN-212 0/7 recorded vs 3 animals recovering to 95-99% in S13-F; S03-J Sham 1/10 vs >=5 by weight), or weights recorded after the recorded death day (S09-C).
claims_affected: Homologous protection magnitude vs PSLN-212 (S03-I), H5N1 2-day protection (S03-J).

finding: MHC-restricted read-outs in mice not stated to carry the restricting haplotype: OT-I (H-2Kb) priming by DCs from donors that default to BALB/c (H-2d); NP366-374 tetramer (H-2Db) in default BALB/c animals. S05-A/B conditions also conflict (ovalbumin vs bivalent vaccine) and have 2 of 3 stated observations.
quantitative_evidence: Annotation: BALB/c default; C57BL/6 only "in the blocks that name them".
required_action: Confirm strain per block; if BALB/c, exclude.

finding: Unvaccinated, unchallenged aged sentinels die during the 14-day window.
quantitative_evidence: 4/21 died (19.0%, 95% CI 5.4-41.9%); S06-G: 3/7 sentinels died - identical to PSLN-344 survival in that experiment (4/7).
claims_affected: Interpretability of every aged survival endpoint (frailty confound).
required_action: Add sentinel arms and pre-specified exclusion rules; health-screen aged cohorts.
